CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2843 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846. Bus nonce: c3a9ad2b44080d28c40a806b66d57f38. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846` or `Fix review: blocked e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: c3a9ad2b44080d28c40a806b66d57f38`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2843 e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2843-c3a9ad2b`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
FULL FIX REVIEW of #2843 (topic r10-996-runner-claims, R10-996-RUNNER-CLAIMS, intended close of issue 996), head e380bebfa2b4a529b857da251d3e26619a1fe846, round 1. Thread reviewer-2843, bus nonce c3a9ad2b44080d28c40a806b66d57f38. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA, with the FINDER's harness (the R10-ARCH-SHAPES round-4 band census, committed by #2819 under dev/audit/harnesses/ and cited in the group brief), not the fixer's. Measure at the head; do not trust the body's figures.

This changes the claim grammar in tests/env_drift.py and the claim-files.md rule (policy under the standing mandate): check that the body says so, and that dev/governance/rules/claim-files.md and its generated .claude/.cursor copies agree (rules_sync --check).
Check: (1) the grammar claims the class the brief names and fails closed: a mutant drift of another shape (a value leaf, another reason pair) is refused; an unchanged tree with the claim present is refused as stale (the null); the parked R10-ARCH-SHAPES-CLASSIFIER arm passes on the macOS, cloud and both runner readings. (2) A fixture cannot be both claimed and may-drift (env_drift.py refuses it). (3) The claim files keep byte-identity with origin/main unless the PR's own claim says otherwise. (4) Mutation proof: delete one line of the real grammar code and run the real driver; a check must go red. (5) The body: ## Red checks answers every red (governance / delivery-status is red on main's overdue rows, not required, not this diff), closing keywords match the roster's fixes (the group brief says to record the decision as a comment on #996: check the body does not claim a close it did not earn), the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2843.md is in the three-dot diff, merge-tree against origin/main exits 0. (6) No VERSION, manifest or RELEASE_NOTES change.

CARRIES (0, from the live roster; each must be answered item by item):

GROUP BRIEF:
GROUP R10-996-RUNNER-CLAIMS (new, size M, orchestrator-sourced under mandate 6329234399, 2026-10-25; reopens the claim-grammar decision of issue #996, whose runner-conditional instance count crosses its reopen threshold with the two R10-ARCH-SHAPES instances). Problem, measured by the R10-ARCH-SHAPES round-4 fixer's band census at d710a5af5 (harness committed by #2819 under dev/audit/harnesses/, cite its sha1): a behaviour change whose golden drift has one direction everywhere but lands on a host-dependent SET of scenarios (the solve's basin moves a planned share in or out of a band) cannot be claimed by any fixed per-fixture claim list: each CI runner host (numeric_probe and numpy_build differ between runs of one PR) reports a different set, so claims go STALE or UNCLAIMED and no state is green on every runner. Design and land a claim grammar in tests/env_drift.py for this class: a claim keyed on the drift's shape (the leaf path pattern and the from/to values), valid across any fixture set, that still refuses any drift outside that shape and any claim that matches nothing on every host the census covers. Fail closed. Controls: the parked R10-ARCH-SHAPES-CLASSIFIER arm passes on the macOS, cloud and both runner readings; a mutant drift of another shape (a value leaf, another reason pair) is refused; an unchanged tree with the claim present is refused as stale (null). Policy: the claim-files.md rule changes, so this is policy under the mandate; say so in the body. Record the decision as a comment on #996 and close the decision there.

Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own (not under the repository). Its first line is exactly `Fix review: merge <full head sha>` or `Fix review: blocked <full head sha> <class>: <reason>`; the next line is `bus-nonce: <the nonce above>`. Then findings and an Evidence section. Push it with tools/audit/seat/bus.sh push-verdict <pr> <VERDICT.md> <evidence dir> per the role contract. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, body or comment. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
